label: Claude Sonnet 5.5

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Hi Owen, Jenna Cole from Brinewatch. Thanks for making the time. How are you monitoring the rooms today?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: We've got six cold rooms and the refrigeration controls came with a monitoring screen. It shows the temperature on a panel in the office and that's about it.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: So it doesn't alert anyone or keep records.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: No, my crew writes the readings in a log twice a day, and our customers' auditors keep asking for continuous records, which we don't have.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Has the gap ever cost you anything?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Last spring a compressor failed on a Sunday and we didn't catch it until Monday. One of our customers filed a claim for $22,000 of product.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: That's a big claim what would have to be true for you to fix this.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Continuous records our customers can see and alerts to whoever's on call at night. We're not big enough to have someone in the building around the clock.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Who would make the call on something like this?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: I run the place, but anything over 15,000 goes to the partners. They meet once a month, and the next meeting is October 20th.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: And is there money for it this year?

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Anything coming up on the customer side.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Our biggest customer audits us in December. I'd like to walk in with a few weeks of clean data.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Then let's work back from the 20th. I'll send a proposal for the six rooms by Friday, and if it helps, I can put together a one-page summary for the partners. What does your paperwork usually look like?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: We use our own vendor agreement and we need a certificate of insurance. A one-pager for the partners would help a lot.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Done, proposal, and one-pager by Friday, and I'll send our insurance certificate with it.

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Great, I'll put it on the agenda for the 20th.
